name: vmware-nsx-security
description: VMware NSX DFW microsegmentation and security: distributed firewall, security groups, tags, traceflow, IDPS
long_description: Runs the published vmware-nsx-security 1.17.4 MCP server locally. This extension starts with read-only tools (expose = read); set it to all to offer write tools, which stay governed by the shared policy and are recorded in the local audit log. Configure targets and credentials with the setup guide first, then point this extension at that config.

config_path.title: vmware-nsx-security config file
config_path.description: config.yaml from the setup guide. Passwords stay in the .env file next to it.

expose.title: Tools to offer
expose.description: read = read-only tools only (default); all = every tool, including writes.
